# YouTube

> > The world's largest video sharing and streaming platform, offering YouTube Premium, YouTube Music, YouTube Kids, YouTube Studio for creators, and live streaming capabilities.

YouTube is Google's video platform serving billions of users worldwide with content ranging from entertainment to education. The platform provides creator tools through YouTube Studio, subscription services like YouTube Premium and YouTube Music, family-friendly content through YouTube Kids, and live streaming for gaming, music, sports, and news.

## Key Topics

- YouTube Premium
- YouTube Music
- YouTube Studio
- YouTube Creators
- YouTube Shorts
- YouTube Kids

- Google Account

- Video streaming
- Creator monetization
- Family supervision
- Live streaming

## Core Platform

- [YouTube](https://youtube.com): Main homepage for YouTube video sharing and streaming platform
- [YouTube Watch](https://youtube.com/watch): Video watch page with footer links and corporate information
- [YouTube Mobile](https://m.youtube.com/index): Mobile YouTube homepage for video sharing and viewing
- [YouTube Live](https://youtube.com/LIVE): YouTube Live streaming hub for gaming, music, sports, and news
- [How YouTube Works](https://youtube.com/howyoutubeworks): Platform overview covering AI, copyright, privacy, and community guidelines

## Subscription Services

- [YouTube Premium](https://youtube.com/premium): YouTube Premium subscription service with ad-free access and downloads
- [YouTube Music](https://music.youtube.com): YouTube Music streaming service requiring Google Chrome browser
- [YouTube Premium Family Plan](https://music.youtube.com/youtube_premium/family): YouTube Premium family plan with background play features

## Creator Tools

- [YouTube Studio](https://studio.youtube.com): YouTube Studio sign-in page for creator dashboard access
- [YouTube Creators FAQ](https://youtube.com/creators/top-questions): YouTube Creators FAQ covering Shorts, Studio, and channel setup
- [Music Channel](https://youtube.com/channel/UC-9-kyTW8ZkZNDHQJ6FgpwQ/featured): Official YouTube Music channel featuring artists and playlists

## Family & Safety

- [YouTube Family](https://youtube.com/myfamily): Family supervision options with YouTube Kids and parental controls

## Help & Support

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://youtube.com/help-and-support/help/frequently-asked-questions): FAQ page with answers to frequently asked YouTube support questions
- [Google Help Channel](https://youtube.com/googlehelp): Official Google Help channel with product tips and tutorials
- [Help Page](https://youtube.com/help-page/faq): Help page for YouTube questions and staff assistance requests

## Official Channels
